Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a Salesforce Developer with expertise in designing, developing, and delivering complex, scalable solutions on the Salesforce platform. 
 The ideal candidate combines deep technical proficiency with the ability to translate business needs into robust, high quality implementations that align with industry’s best practices.
 YOUR ROLE 
Design, develop, and maintain custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs.
Implementation and maintenance of triggers, Apex classes, batch jobs, and schedulers.
Configure and customize Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, and Flows.
Development of Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura components for customized interfaces.
Building and maintaining robust integration between Salesforce and external system using REST/SOAP APIs.
Optimizing Apex code and SOQL/SOSL queries for high performance.
Implement and maintain Salesforce security models, including profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules.
Collaborating with internal teams (Admins, Business Analysts, Project Managers) to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Optimize system performance, data quality, and user experience within the Salesforce platform.
Managing the deployment process (Change Sets, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD tools).
Develop and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and Salesforce deployment requirements.
 YOUR PROFILE 
 Min 3 years’ experience in Salesforce development with:
Salesforce Sales Cloud/ Service Cloud,
Apex programming,
Lightning Web Components (LWC),
Hand son experience of Salesforce integration with other external systems (REST/SOAP APIs)
Git and CI/CD tools
Agile/Scrum methodologies
Aura Framework.
Experience with declarative Salesforce tools (Flows, Process Builder) and a good understanding of how to balance configuration versus code
Solid knowledge of Salesforce best practices, design patterns, governor limits, security model.
 Bachelor’s Degree: Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or Finance.
 WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE 
Flexible and dynamic work environment involving teams spread across different global locations;
Communities with shared interests and identities, all working together to advance diversity, equity and inclusion within the workplace and society;
Do you want to learn more? You will have access to various training programs and platforms (e.g.: content provided by Pluralsight, Harvard and Coursera);
Attractive benefits package (meal tickets, medical services, Benefit online, Employee Share Option Plan).
 Capgemini is an equal opportunity employer. We promote equality and dignity in all aspects of recruitment and employment, and all offers of employment and promotions are made on the basis of performance, competence and ability.
 About Us 
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations.
